﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (مَن): a jussive conditional noun, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يضلل﴾; (يضلل): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), given a kasra because of the meeting of two sukūns; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil; the fāʾ: [the fāʾ] in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ما): negating; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿هاد﴾; (مِن): a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] preposition; (هاد): the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative in position, genitive by ﴿مِن﴾ in form; the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ذلك هدى الله﴾, and the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. [Translator's note: the source calls this clause both conjoined and resumptive; translated as written.]

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿أفمن يتقي بوجهه سوء العذاب يوم القيامة﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the fāʾ is a conjunction joining to an implied clause understood from the content of the context, i.e. "Are all people equal? Then is one who guards…"; (من): a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يتقي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by an implied (muqaddara) ḍamma; the clause ﴿يتقي بوجهه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. (بوجهه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتقي﴾, and the pronoun is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (سوء): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr); (يوم): an adverb attached to ﴿يتقي﴾; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; and the khabar (predicate) of (من) is omitted, its implied form being "like one who is safe from the punishment".
﴿وقيل للظالمين ذوقوا ما كنتم تكسبون﴾: the wāw is for the ḥāl (circumstantial); (قيل): past verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], and the clause ﴿قيل﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl. (للظالمين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قيل﴾; (ذوقوا): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ذوقوا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of ﴿قيل﴾; (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (كنتم): (كان) is a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the tāʾ is its noun; (تكسبون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿تكسبون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ﴿كنتم﴾.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t: ﴿كذب الذين من قبلهم فأتاهم العذاب من حيث لا يشعرون﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; (كذب): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (من قبلهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذين﴾, and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position. (هم): an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (فأتاهم): the fāʾ: a conjunction, and (أتاهم): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif, and (هم) is in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (العذاب): the delayed fāʿil, nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿فأتاهم العذاب﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿كذب الذين﴾; (من حيث): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أتاهم﴾; (لا): negating; (يشعرون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿لا يشعرون﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿فأذاقهم الله الخزي في الحياة الدنيا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أذاقهم): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and (هم) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); (الخزي): the second mafʿūl bihi; (في الحياة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أذاقهم﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (الدنيا): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿الحياة﴾, genitive (majrūr).
﴿ولعذاب الآخرة أكبر لو كانوا يعلمون﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām: the lām of inception (lām al-ibtidāʾ); (عذاب): mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (الآخرة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; (أكبر): khabar (predicate), nominative; (لو): conditional; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يعلمون﴾ is its khabar; the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, and the object of (يعلمون) is also omitted, its implied form being "its punishment".

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿ولقد ضربنا للناس في هذا القرآن من كل مثل﴾: the wāw: resumptive; the lām: [the lām of] the answer to an omitted oath; (قد): a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (ضرب): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and ﴿نا﴾: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿ضربنا﴾ is the answer to an implied oath, and the implied oath clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ضربنا﴾ as a second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), because (ضرب) is made to include the meaning of (جعل); (في): a preposition; (هذا): a demonstrative, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿ضربنا﴾; (القرآن): a badal (substitute) or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition), genitive (majrūr); (من): a preposition; (كل): a genitive noun; (مثل): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of the first object of ﴿ضربنا﴾, i.e. "a parable being of every kind of parable"; and the clause ﴿ولقد ضربنا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿لعلهم يتذكرون﴾: (لعل): a particle of hope (tarajjī) that makes [its noun] accusative, and (هم) is its noun; (يتذكرون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يتذكرون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لعل﴾; and the clause ﴿لعلهم يتذكرون﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan) or causal (taʿlīliyya), and on both views it has no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿قرآنا عربيا غير ذي عوج لعلهم يتقون﴾: (قرآنا): either accusative by way of praise (ʿalā al-madḥ), or accusative by ﴿يتذكرون﴾, or as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (القرآن), being an emphatic ḥāl, which is called ﴿موطئة﴾ "preparatory", because the ḥāl in reality is ﴿عربيا﴾, and ﴿قرآنا﴾ is a preparation for it; (عربيا): a naʿt (adjective), accusative (manṣūb); (غير): a second naʿt of ﴿قرآنا﴾, accusative; (ذي): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) by the yāʾ, because it is one of the Six Nouns (al-asmāʾ al-sitta); (عوج): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra; (لعل): a particle of hope (tarajjī) that makes [its noun] accusative; (هم): an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of ﴿لعل﴾; (يتقون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يتقون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of ﴿لعل﴾; and the clause ﴿لعلهم يتقون﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan) with no grammatical position, or causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿ضرب الله مثلا رجلا فيه شركاء متشاكسون ورجلا سلما لرجل هل يستويان مثلا﴾: (ضرب): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent); (مثلا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (رجلا): a badal (substitute) from ﴿مثلا﴾, accusative; (فيه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (شركاء): the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); the nominal clause: an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿رجلا﴾; (متشاكسون): a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿شركاء﴾; (رجلا): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿رجلا﴾; (سلمًا): a naʿt by means of the maṣdar (verbal noun), by way of intensification (mubālagha); (لرجل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿سلما﴾; (هل): an interrogative particle, indeclinable on the sukūn; (يستويان): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the alif is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يستويان﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan), with no grammatical position; (مثلا): a tamyīz (specification) converted from the fāʿil, i.e. "their likeness is not equal".
﴿الحمد لله بل أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: (الحمد): mubtadaʾ, nominative; (لله): the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted khabar; the clause ﴿الحمد لله﴾ is parenthetical and supplicatory (iʿtirāḍiyya duʿāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; (بل): a particle of digression (iḍrāb) and conjunction; (أكثرهم): mubtadaʾ, nominative, and (هم) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا): negating; (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿إنك ميت﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); the kāf: its noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative; (ميت): the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ).
﴿وإنهم ميتون﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (إن): an abrogating particle, and (هم) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of (إن); (ميتون): the khabar of (إن), nominative by the wāw, because it is a sound masculine plural; the clause ﴿إنك ميت..﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿وإنهم ميتون﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿إنك ميت﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t: ﴿ثم إنكم يوم القيامة عند ربكم تختصمون﴾: (ثم): a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī); (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and (كم): an indeclinable (mabnī) pronoun in the position of the accusative as the noun of (إن); (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative (manṣūb), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يختصمون﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source, with yāʾ; the Quranic word is ﴿تختصمون﴾]; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (عند): an adverb of place, accusative; (رب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and (كم): an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (تختصمون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تختصمون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿إن﴾; and the clause ﴿إنكم يوم القيامة عند ربكم تختصمون﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿إنهم ميتون﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿فمن أظلم ممن كذب على الله وكذب بالصدق إذ جاءه﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (من): an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (أظلم): khabar (predicate), nominative (marfūʿ); (من): a preposition, and (مَن): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أظلم﴾; (كذب): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (على): a preposition, and (الله): the Name of Majesty, a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿كذب﴾; the clause ﴿من أظلم﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿كذب على الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. (كذب): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil: "he"; (بالصدق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿كذب﴾; the clause ﴿كذب بالصدق﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿كذب على الله﴾; (إذ): an adverb attached to ﴿كذب﴾; (جاءه): (جاء) is an indeclinable past verb, the fāʿil: "he", and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿جاءه﴾ is in the position of the genitive by being in construct (bi-l-iḍāfa).
﴿أليس في جهنم مثوى للكافرين﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); (ليس): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); (في جهنم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of (ليس); (مثوى): the delayed noun of (ليس), nominative by a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif; (للكافرين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿مثوى﴾; and the clause ﴿ليس في جهنم مثوى﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿والذي جاء بالصدق وصدق به﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الذي): mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿جاء بالصدق﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذي), with no grammatical position. And ﴿صدق﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the ṣila.
﴿أولئك هم المتقون﴾: (أولئك): mubtadaʾ; (هم): a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); (المتقون): the khabar (predicate) of (أولئك); the nominal clause is the khabar of (الذي); and the clause ﴿والذي جاء...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t: ﴿لهم ما يشاءون عند ربهم ذلك جزاء المحسنين﴾: (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of the nominative as the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject); (يشاءون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿لهم ما يشاءون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿الذي﴾, or in the position of the nominative as a second khabar of ﴿أولئك﴾; the clause ﴿يشاءون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. (عند): an adverb, accusative (manṣūb), attached to ﴿يشاء﴾; (رب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and the pronoun ﴿هم﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (ذلك): a demonstrative, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (جزاء): khabar, nominative; (المحسنين): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the yāʾ, because it is a sound masculine plural; and the clause ﴿ذلك جزاء المحسنين﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿ليكفر الله عنهم أسوأ الذي عملوا﴾: the lām is for purpose (taʿlīl); (يكفر): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām of purpose; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يكفر﴾ is genitive (majrūr) by the lām, [the two] attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿المحسنين﴾; (الله): the Name of Majesty, the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يكفر﴾, nominative (marfūʿ); (عنهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يكفر﴾; (أسوأ): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative; (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (عملوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿عملوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويجزيهم أجرهم بأحسن الذي كانوا يعملون﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (يجزيهم): imperfect verb, accusative, conjoined to ﴿يكفر﴾, the fāʿil is "he", the hāʾ is the first mafʿūl bihi, and the mīm is for the plural; (أجر): the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يجزيهم﴾, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi; (بأحسن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجزيهم﴾; (الذي): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; (يعملون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿كانوا يعملون﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿الذي﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿أليس الله بكاف عبده﴾: (أليس): the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī), and (ليس): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa; (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of (ليس), nominative (marfūʿ); the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] preposition; (كاف): genitive (majrūr) in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar (predicate) of (ليس); (عبد): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿كاف﴾, accusative, and the hāʾ: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿أليس الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ويخوفونك بالذين من دونه﴾: the wāw: circumstantial (ḥāliyya) or resumptive; (يخوفونك): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the kāf is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; (بالذين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يخوفونك﴾; (من دونه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause), and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position; and the clause ﴿ويخوفونك...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد﴾: the wāw: resumptive; (مَن): a jussive conditional noun, in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يضلل﴾; (يضلل): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm); (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; the fāʾ: [the fāʾ] in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ما): negating; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿هاد﴾; (مِن): a connective [i.e. redundant] preposition; (هاد): the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position, genitive in form by a kasra implied beneath the yāʾ, which is omitted because of the meeting of two sukūns; the clause ﴿يضلل الله﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿من﴾; the clause ﴿ما له من هاد﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ; and the clause ﴿ومن يضلل الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (من): a jussive conditional noun, in the position of the accusative (manṣūb) as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿يهد﴾; (يهد): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the yāʾ; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the fāʾ: [the fāʾ] in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ما): negating; (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿مضل﴾, fronted; (من): a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] preposition; (مضل): the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative in position, genitive in form.
﴿أليس الله بعزيز ذي انتقام﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of affirmation (al-istifhām al-taqrīrī); (ليس): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); (الله): the Name of Majesty, the noun of (ليس), nominative; (بعزيز): the bāʾ is a connective [i.e. redundant] preposition, and (عزيز): genitive in form, accusative in position as the khabar of (ليس); (ذي): a naʿt (adjective), genitive by the yāʾ, because it is one of the Six Nouns (al-asmāʾ al-sitta); (انتقام): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive; the clause ﴿من يهد الله﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿من يضلل الله﴾, the clause ﴿يهد الله﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (مَن), and ﴿ما له من مضل﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the clause ﴿أليس الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿ولئن سألتهم من خلق السماوات والأرض ليقولن الله﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; the lām is preparatory to the oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن): conditional; (سألتهم): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the plural, and the clause is in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (من): an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (خلق): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "he"; (السماوات): mafʿūl bihi, accusative (manṣūb) by the kasra; (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined), accusative by the fatḥa; the clause ﴿خلق السماوات والأرض﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿من﴾; the clause ﴿من خلق ...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿سألتهم﴾, which is suspended (muʿallaqa) from operating by the interrogative; the lām: occurring in the answer to the oath, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted; (يقولن): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, which is omitted because of the succession of like letters; (الله): the Name of Majesty, the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "He is Allah", or a mubtadaʾ with the khabar omitted, i.e. "created them".
﴿قل أفرأيتم ما تدعون من دون الله﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the fāʿil is "you" (أنت); the hamza is for interrogation, and the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); (رأيتم): an indeclinable past verb and its fāʿil; (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the first object of ﴿رأيتم﴾; (تدعون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن أرادني الله بضر هل هن كاشفات ضره﴾: (إن): conditional; (أرادني): a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi; (الله): the Name of Majesty, fāʿil, nominative; (بضر): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرادني﴾; (هل): an interrogative particle; (هن): a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (كاشفات): khabar, nominative; (ضر): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the interrogative clause ﴿هل هن كاشفات﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the second object of ﴿رأيتم﴾.
﴿أو أرادني برحمة هل هن ممسكات رحمته﴾: (أو): a conjunction; (أرادني): a past verb and a fronted mafʿūl bihi, and the fāʿil is "he"; (برحمة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرادني﴾; (هل): an interrogative particle; (هن): a pronoun of separation, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (ممسكات): khabar, nominative; (رحمته): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive by the kasra, and the hāʾ is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿قل حسبي الله عليه يتوكل المتوكلون﴾: (قل): imperative, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the fāʿil is "you" (أنت); (حسبي): a fronted khabar, nominative by a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ; the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾: the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; the clause ﴿حسبي الله﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوكل﴾; (يتوكل): imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma; (المتوكلون): fāʿil, nominative by the wāw; and the clause ﴿يتوكل المتوكلون﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t: ﴿قل يا قوم اعملوا على مكانتكم إني عامل فسوف تعلمون﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿قل﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (يا): a vocative particle; (قوم): the one addressed (munādā), in construct, accusative (manṣūb) by a fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the letter before the yāʾ, which is omitted for lightness; the clause ﴿يا قوم﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of ﴿قل﴾; (اعملوا): imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (على مكانتكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿اعملوا﴾; and there is an omission in the speech, i.e. "on my position"; the clause ﴿اعملوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, and it is the answer to the vocative; (إني): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters) and the yāʾ is its noun; (عامل): the khabar (predicate) of (إن), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; the clause ﴿إني عامل﴾ is an explanatory resumptive (mustaʾnafa bayāniyyan), with no grammatical position; the fāʾ: a conjunction; (سوف): a particle of futurity; (تعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿فسوف تعلمون﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿من يأتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم﴾: (من): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the object of ﴿تعلمون﴾; (يأتي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the yāʾ, and the hāʾ: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يأتيه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿من﴾, with no grammatical position. (عذاب): the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يأتيه﴾, nominative by the ḍamma; (يخزي): imperfect verb, nominative by a ḍamma implied on the yāʾ, and the hāʾ: an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يخزيه﴾ is in the position of the nominative as an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿عذاب﴾; (ويحل): the wāw: a conjunction, and (يحل) is an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma; (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يحل﴾; (عذاب): the fāʿil of ﴿يحل﴾, nominative by the ḍamma; (مقيم): a naʿt (adjective), nominative by the ḍamma; and the clause ﴿يحل عذاب﴾ is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to ﴿يخزيه﴾.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿إنا أنزلنا عليك الكتاب للناس بالحق﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾, whose nūn is omitted for lightness, is the noun of (إن); (أنزلنا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and (نا) is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أنزلنا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (الكتاب): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); (للناس): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزلنا﴾; (بالحق): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "clothed with it", so it is [a ḥāl] from the fāʿil or from the object; and the clause ﴿إنا أنزلنا﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فمن اهتدى فلنفسه ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (من): a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (اهتدى): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif, in the position of the jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the fāʾ: [the fāʾ] in the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (لنفسه): the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then his guidance is for himself", and the clause ﴿لنفسه﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis, joined with the fāʾ; and the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿من﴾; (من): a jussive conditional noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ; (ضل): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive as the protasis, and the fāʿil is "he"; the fāʾ is the linking [fāʾ] for the apodosis; (إنما): the restraining [particle] and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (يضل): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil is "he"; (عليها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يضل﴾; the clause ﴿من اهتدى﴾ has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ﴿إنا أنزلنا﴾; the clause ﴿ومن ضل فإنما يضل عليها﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿من اهتدى...﴾; and the clause ﴿إنما يضل عليها﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis.
﴿وما أنت عليهم بوكيل﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (ما): the Ḥijāzī negating (mā) that operates like (ليس); (أنت): a detached pronoun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as the noun of (ما); (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿وكيل﴾; ﴿بوكيل﴾: the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] preposition, and ﴿وكيل﴾ is the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position, genitive by the bāʾ in form; and the clause ﴿ما أنت عليهم بوكيل﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿الله يتوفى الأنفس حين موتها والتي لم تمت في منامها﴾: the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾: mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); (يتوفى): imperfect verb, nominative by a ḍamma implied (muqaddara) on the alif, and the fāʿil (agent) is "he"; (الأنفس): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; the clause ﴿يتوفى الأنفس﴾: in the position of the nominative as khabar (predicate); (حين): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتوفى﴾; (موت): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr), and (ها): muḍāf ilayhi; the wāw: a conjunction; (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, conjoined to (الأنفس); (لم): a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]; (تمت): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), and the fāʿil is "she"; the clause ﴿لم تمت في منامها﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position. ﴿في منامها﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوفى﴾, and ﴿ها﴾: muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿فيمسك التي قضى عليها الموت ويرسل الأخرى إلى أجل مسمى﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (يمسك): imperfect verb, nominative, conjoined to ﴿يتوفى﴾; (التي): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative as the object of ﴿يمسك﴾; the clause ﴿قضى عليها الموت﴾: the ṣila of ﴿التي﴾, with no grammatical position. (قضى): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (الموت): mafʿūl bihi of ﴿قضى﴾, accusative; (يرسل): conjoined to (يمسك); (الأخرى): mafʿūl bihi, accusative by a fatḥa implied on the alif; (إلى أجل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرسل﴾ or to ﴿يمسك﴾; (مسمى): a naʿt (adjective) of (أجل), genitive by an implied kasra.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يتفكرون﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (في ذلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (آيات): the noun of (إن), accusative by the kasra, because it is a sound feminine plural; (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿آيات﴾; (يتفكرون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿إن في ذلك لآيات﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya), with no grammatical position, and the clause ﴿يتفكرون﴾ is a naʿt of (قوم).

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿أم اتخذوا من دون الله شفعاء﴾: (أم): a conjunction, and it is the disconnected (munqaṭiʿa) [أم], in the sense of (بل) plus the interrogative hamza, and the interrogative is one of denial (inkārī); (اتخذوا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb ﴿اتخذوا﴾; (الله): the Name of Majesty, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (شفعاء): the first object of (اتخذوا); and the clause ﴿اتخذوا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿قل أولو كانوا لا يملكون شيئا﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, and the fāʿil is "you" (أنت); the hamza is for the interrogative of denial, and what it governs is omitted, its implied form being "Will they intercede?" (أيشفعون); the wāw: circumstantial (ḥāliyya); (لو): conditional; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; (لا): negating; (يملكون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يملكون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of (كان); (شيئا): mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿لو كانوا ...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of the implied ﴿يشفعون﴾; and the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.
﴿ولا يعقلون﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (لا): prohibitive (nāhiya) [Translator's note: so in the source; the verb here is nominative, so (لا) is negating (nāfiya)]; (يعقلون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿لا يعقلون﴾ is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause ﴿لا يملكون﴾.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t: ﴿قل لله الشفاعة جميعا له ملك السماوات والأرض ثم إليه ترجعون﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); (لله): the lām is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (الشفاعة): the delayed mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿لله الشفاعة﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying; (جميعًا): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الشفاعة), accusative (manṣūba); and the clause ﴿قل لله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. (له): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; (ملك): the delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative; (السماوات): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿السماوات﴾, genitive by the kasra; (ثم): a conjunction for sequence and delay (tarākhī); (إليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ترجعون﴾; (ترجعون): imperfect verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause ﴿ترجعون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿له الملك﴾ [Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic wording is ﴿له ملك﴾].

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿وإذا ذكر الله وحده اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb of future time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿اشمأزت﴾; (ذكر): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive]; the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), nominative (marfūʿ); the clause ﴿ذكر الله﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it; (وحده): a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the Name of Majesty, accusative (manṣūb); (اشمأزت): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the tāʾ is for the feminine; (قلوب): fāʿil (agent), nominative by the ḍamma; (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا): negating; (يؤمنون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يؤمنون..﴾: the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿اشمأزت قلوب الذين لا يؤمنون بالآخرة﴾: has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وإذا ذكر الذين من دونه إذا هم يستبشرون﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb of future time, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, containing the meaning of condition; (ذكر): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive]; a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as nāʾib fāʿil [Translator's note: the source omits the word being parsed here, i.e. (الذين)]; (من دونه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila of (الذين), and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position. (إذا): [the إذا] of surprise (al-fujāʾiyya), with no grammatical position; (هم): an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يستبشرون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يستبشرون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿هم﴾; and the clause ﴿هم يستبشرون﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of the non-jussive condition.

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿قل اللهم فاطر السماوات والأرض عالم الغيب والشهادة﴾: (قل): imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the fāʿil (agent): "you" (أنت); (اللهم): the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾, a singular one addressed (munādā mufrad), indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and the doubled mīm is a substitute for the omitted ﴿يا﴾; (فاطر): a naʿt (adjective), accusative (manṣūb), or a one addressed in construct (munādā muḍāf), accusative; (السماوات): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (الأرض): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to (السماوات), genitive; (عالم): a second naʿt, accusative, or a one addressed in construct, accusative; (الغيب): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; (الشهادة): conjoined to (الغيب), genitive.
﴿أنت تحكم بين عبادك في ما كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾: (أنت): a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (تحكم): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and the fāʿil: "you" (أنت); the clause ﴿تحكم﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿أنت﴾; (بين): an adverb of place, accusative, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿تحكم﴾; (عبادك): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive, and the kāf is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (فيما): a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿تحكم﴾; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿يختلفون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of (كانوا); (فيه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يختلفون﴾; the clause ﴿كانوا فيه يختلفون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿اللهم فاطر ...﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying, and the clause ﴿قل اللهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ولو أن للذين ظلموا ما في الأرض جميعا ومثله معه لافتدوا به من سوء العذاب يوم القيامة﴾: the wāw: resumptive; (لو): conditional; (أن): a maṣdar-forming particle for emphasis; (للذين): the lām is a preposition and (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the genitive, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (أن); (ظلموا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable, in the position of the accusative as the delayed noun of (أن); (في الأرض): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position. (جميعًا): a ḥāl (circumstantial), accusative (manṣūba), from the referent pronoun (ʿāʾid) of (ما); (ومثله): the wāw: a conjunction, and (مثله) is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿ما﴾; (معه): an adverb attached to an omitted ḥāl; the lām is occurring in the apodosis (jawāb) of (لو); (افتدوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma implied (muqaddar) on the alif, and the wāw is the fāʿil; (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿افتدوا﴾; (من سوء): a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿افتدوا﴾; (العذاب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr); (يوم): an adverb of time, accusative, attached to ﴿افتدوا﴾; (القيامة): muḍāf ilayhi, genitive; the clause ﴿افتدوا﴾ is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and the clause ﴿ولو أن للذين ظلموا...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وبدا لهم من الله ما لم يكونوا يحتسبون﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (بدا): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied on the alif; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بدا﴾; (من الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl; (ما): fāʿil; (لم): a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]; (يكونوا): a deficient imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is its noun; the clause ﴿لم يكونوا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. (يحتسبون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿بدا...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿افتدوا..﴾, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿يحتسبون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar of ﴿يكونوا﴾; and the referent pronoun is omitted, i.e. "they reckoned it" (يحتسبونه).

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وبدا لهم سيئات ما كسبوا﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (بدا): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿بدا﴾; (سيئات): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كسبوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿وبدا لهم سيئات...﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿وبدا لهم من الله...﴾, and the clause ﴿كسبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزئون﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (حاق): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; (بهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿حاق﴾; (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is the noun of (كان); (به): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يستهزئون﴾; (يستهزئون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿حاق بهم ما﴾ is conjoined to ﴿بدا لهم سيئات...﴾; and the clause ﴿يستهزئون﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿كانوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿فإذا مس الإنسان ضر دعانا﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb of future time, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, containing the meaning of condition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دعانا﴾; (مس): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa; (الإنسان): a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb) by the fatḥa; (ضر): fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma; (دعا): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif, the fāʿil is "he", and (نا) is an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl bihi. The clause ﴿دعانا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb) of (إذا).
﴿ثم إذا خولناه نعمة منا قال إنما أوتيته على علم﴾: (ثم): a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī); (إذا): an adverb of future time, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the accusative, containing the meaning of condition; (خولناه): past verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, (نا) is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi; (نعمة): the second mafʿūl bihi; (منا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿نعمة﴾; the clause ﴿خولناه﴾: in the position of the genitive by the adverb's being put in construct with it. (قال): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa, and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause ﴿قال﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; (إنما): the restraining [particle] and the restrained (kāffa wa-makfūfa); (أوتيته): past verb, built for that whose agent is not named [i.e. passive], the tāʾ: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent), and the hāʾ: the second mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿أوتيته﴾ is in the position of the accusative as the speech (maqūl) of the saying; (على علم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the nāʾib fāʿil of ﴿أوتيته﴾.
﴿بل هي فتنة ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: (بل): a particle of transitional digression (iḍrāb intiqālī); (هي): a detached pronoun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (فتنة): khabar (predicate), nominative by the ḍamma; the clause ﴿هي فتنة﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is resumptive; (ولكن): the wāw: circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and (لكن): a particle of rectification (istidrāk) that makes [its noun] accusative; (أكثر): the noun of (لكن), accusative, and (هم) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (لا): negating; (يعلمون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿لا يعلمون﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of ﴿لكن﴾; and the clause ﴿لكن أكثرهم﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿هي فتنة﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿قد قالها الذين من قبلهم﴾: (قد): a particle of verification (taḥqīq); (قالها): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, and ﴿ها﴾ is a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), ﴿ها﴾ referring to their statement; (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as fāʿil (agent); (من قبلهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿الذين﴾, and the clause of the ṣila has no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿قالها الذين..﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فما أغنى عنهم ما كانوا يكسبون﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (ما): negating; (أغنى): past verb, indeclinable on the fatḥa implied (muqaddara) on the alif; (عنهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أغنى﴾; (ما): a relative noun, indeclinable on the sukūn, in the position of the nominative as the fāʿil of ﴿أغنى﴾; (كانوا): a deficient past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the wāw is the noun of (كان); the clause ﴿ما أغنى عنهم..﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿قالها الذين..﴾; (يكسبون): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يكسبون﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the clause ﴿كانوا﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿فأصابهم سيئات ما كسبوا﴾: the fāʾ: a conjunction; (أصابهم): past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, the hāʾ is in the position of the accusative as a fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the mīm is for the plural; (سيئات): the delayed fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ); (ما): relative or maṣdar-forming, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (كسبوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿أصابهم سيئات﴾ is maʿṭūf (conjoined) to the clause ﴿ما أغنى﴾, and the clause ﴿كسبوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿والذين ظلموا من هؤلاء سيصيبهم سيئات ما كسبوا وما هم بمعجزين﴾: the wāw: a conjunction; (الذين): a relative noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (ظلموا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿ظلموا﴾: the ṣila of ﴿الذين﴾, with no grammatical position. (من هؤلاء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ﴿ظلموا﴾; (سيصيبهم): the sīn is for the future, and (يصيبهم) is an imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma, and ﴿هم﴾ is mafʿūl bihi; (سيئات): fāʿil, nominative by the ḍamma; (ما): relative or maṣdar-forming, in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; (كسبوا): past verb, indeclinable on the ḍamma, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿سيصيبهم سيئات ما كسبوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (الذين); (ما): the Ḥijāzī negating (mā) that operates like (ليس); (هم): an indeclinable pronoun in the position of the nominative as the noun of the Ḥijāzī (ما); the bāʾ: a connective (ṣila) [i.e. redundant] preposition; (معجزين): genitive (majrūr) by the bāʾ in form, accusative (manṣūb) in position as the khabar of (ما); and the clause ﴿ما هم بمعجزين﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the hāʾ in (سيصيبهم).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿أولم يعلموا أن الله يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر﴾: the hamza is for the interrogative of denial (al-istifhām al-inkārī), and the wāw: a conjunction joining to something omitted, its implied form being: "Did they say it, and did they not know?"; (لم): a particle of negation, jussive and conversion [to the past]; (يعلموا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil (agent); (أن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty ﴿الله﴾ is the noun of (إن); (يبسط): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "he"; (الرزق): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), accusative (manṣūb); the clause ﴿يبسط الرزق﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن الله..﴾ stands in place of the two objects of (يعلموا); (لمن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يبسط﴾; (يشاء): imperfect verb, nominative by the ḍamma, and the fāʿil is "he"; (ويقدر): the wāw: a conjunction, and (يقدر): imperfect verb, nominative, conjoined to (يشاء), and the fāʿil is "he"; the clause ﴿يشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. And the clause ﴿يقدر..﴾ has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ﴿يشاء..﴾.
﴿إن في ذلك لآيات لقوم يؤمنون﴾: (إن): an abrogating particle; (في ذلك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of (إن); the lām is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); (آيات): the delayed noun of (إن), accusative, the sign of its accusative being the kasra; (لقوم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿آيات﴾; (يؤمنون): imperfect verb, nominative by the retention of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; and the clause ﴿يؤمنون﴾ is an adjective of ﴿قوم﴾.
